title: Improper access control in AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware could allow a malicious hypervisor to…
description: CVE-2025-0027 is a medium severity vulnerability in AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware. It involves improper access control that could allow a malicious hypervisor to bypass Reverse Map Table (RMP) protections. This bypass may impact the integrity of SEV-SNP guest memory, potentially undermining the security guarantees of the virtualization environment.
